approval: User selected Runtime and metadata inspection.

ownership.coordinator_reservations: No matching ticket entries in current repository goal event JSON/YAML.
ownership.other_base_agents: Observed; unrelated agents left untouched. No child launch or takeover.

reads: Same root account, boot ID and production-base identity guards.
Xochitl service active state, main PID, stop policy/control-group/unit-path properties; its main executable link only. No service mutation or ExecStart/environment dump.

One proc exe-link scan matching exactly the prior preflight patterns; at most four matching processes. For each: PID/start ticks, proc/executable metadata, executable path and code SHA-256 up to 32 MiB, and Name/State/PPid/Uid/Gid only. Stable identity required before/after.
Tool existence, mv --help, free space, exact proposed release/stage/backup path absence, and QMD names.

operations.requires: Explicit runtime-and-metadata approval and successful operation 1 complete marker; never proceed after an error or partial identity.
argv:
sh -c 'set -eu
fail() { printf '\''STOP=%s\n'\'' "$1" >&2; exit 41; }
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail account
[ "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = '\''8e816d98-6bf4-4f9e-9abe-891fbf83d06f'\'' ] || fail boot_changed
base='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge'\''
dir='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0019'\''
helper='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0019/metadata-reader'\''
for path in / /home /home/root /home/root/.local /home/root/.local/share "$base"; do
 [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] || fail parent_type
 [ "$(stat -c %u "$path")" = 0 ] || fail parent_owner
done
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$base")" = '\''65026:1150:0:0:700'\'' ] || fail base_identity_changed
# Observation only: the unchanged reader checks stable private-file descriptors.
# A live backend is permitted for this snapshot, never for an installation cutover.
printf '\''OBSERVATION_ONLY_NO_QUIESCENCE_ATTESTATION\n'\''
[ ! -e "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] || fail helper_directory_occupied
umask 077
mkdir -m 700 "$dir"
dir_identity=$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$dir")
set -C
cat > "$helper"
[ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] || fail helper_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")" = '\''0:0:600:2162872'\'' ] || fail helper_metadata
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''0fe207302d7feb59fe6ff9a6beb407950d9fce9386522b533ad0868514d9e7ed  /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0019/metadata-reader'\'' | sha256sum -c -
chmod 700 "$helper"
helper_identity=$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")
printf '\''READER_DIRECTORY_IDENTITY=%s\nREADER_FILE_IDENTITY=%s\n'\'' "$dir_identity" "$helper_identity"
"$helper"
[ -d "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] || fail cleanup_directory_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$dir")" = "$dir_identity" ] || fail cleanup_directory_identity
[ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] || fail cleanup_helper_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")" = "$helper_identity" ] || fail cleanup_helper_identity
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''0fe207302d7feb59fe6ff9a6beb407950d9fce9386522b533ad0868514d9e7ed  /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0019/metadata-reader'\'' | sha256sum -c -
rm -- "$helper"
rmdir -- "$dir"
printf '\''OWNED_READER_REMOVED\n'\''
'
operations.concurrency_scope: Only this observation lifecycle permits an active backend. The unchanged reader opens fixed root-owned 0600 regular files with no-follow/nonblocking flags, bounded reads, fixed config/CA hashes and stable descriptor checks. It emits only metadata, hashes and path/trust booleans; never values or tokens. A snapshot is not a quiescence attestation or permission to install.
operations.cleanup: After success only: recheck exact new directory and helper identities and helper hash, remove only this helper and its empty new directory. On any failure preserve all new paths and stop; no traps, retries or cleanup of other files.
